title: Wordmark / Logo minimum sizes

location.extent: Complete photographed spread from one GIF frame

slide_intent: Set reproduction limits because recognition fails when a mark’s detail becomes too small.
strategic_value: Specified small-scale assets and minimums can preserve the relationship between Freddie and the Mailchimp name.
demonstration: A photographed spread pairs sizing instructions at left with reversed and positive horizontal logos at right.
practical_value: Distinguish digital and print minimums and retain the prescribed small-scale lockup.

content_islands.name: Instructions
content_islands.spec: Keep the explanatory text above separate digital and print size notes on the left page.

content_islands.name: Logo comparison
content_islands.spec: Stack a light logo on black above a black logo on white on the right page.

content_islands.name: Folio
content_islands.spec: Retain printed folio 52 and Version 1.0 footer.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explicitly connects minimum sizing to legibility and impact.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source states minimums of 70px vertical and 100px horizontal for digital; 20mm vertical and 25mm horizontal for print. It also prohibits changing the Freddie–wordmark relationship in special small-scale assets.
reference_purposes.Application: Positive and reversed examples demonstrate the horizontal signature.

ingredient.name: Logo minimum reproduction
ingredient.role: Preserve the mark’s legibility and internal relationship.
ingredient.application: Use the stated digital minimums of 70px vertical / 100px horizontal and print minimums of 20mm vertical / 25mm horizontal. Use the designated small-scale assets without changing Freddie relative to the wordmark.
ingredient.scope: Historical Version 1.0 excerpt. The text does not identify the measured axis; do not invent one. The referenced asset toolkit is not included.
